phrases.modeTitre: How do you want to play?
phrases.modeDesc: The same 20 sentences, two ways to play them. You can switch between two rounds.
phrases.modeLectureTitre: You both finish it, then move on
phrases.modeLectureDesc: The sentence appears, you both finish it out loud, and you tap next when you're done talking about it.
phrases.modeChronoTitre: You answer at the same time
phrases.modeChronoDesc: A 3-second countdown, and on "GO" you both say your answer at the same moment. Then you say whether it was the same.
phrases.modeChronoMeta: With a score at the end
phrases.chronoAide: Say your answer at the same time, both of you.
phrases.pareilTitre: Did you say the same thing?
phrases.finSousLecture: You can start again, the sentences won't come back in the same order. Or try the countdown mode, where you both answer at the same time.
phrases.finSousChrono: That's how many times you said the same thing at the same moment.
phrases.verdict1: You barely said anything in common. It happens more often than you'd think, and it mostly gives you something to talk about: go back over the sentences where your answers were opposites.
phrases.verdict2: You agreed on some of the sentences only. On all the others, each of you had their own idea in mind.
phrases.verdict3: You said the same thing more than half the time, without talking it over first. That's already a lot!
phrases.verdict4: Almost all your answers were identical. At that point, you don't need to talk to understand each other!
phrases.recommencer: Play again with the sentences shuffled
